n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 505
C = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
f = [0] * N
g = [0] * N
ff = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
gg = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

def add(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= mod:
        x -= mod
    return x

# Compute binomial coefficients
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        val1 = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        val2 = (C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        val3 = (i + 1) % mod
        f[i] = add(f[i], (val1 * val2) % mod * val3 % mod)

        val4 = (g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        g[i] = add(g[i], (val4 * val2) % mod * val3 % mod)

        val5 = (g[i - j] * f[j - 1]) % mod
        g[i] = add(g[i], (val5 * val2) % mod * val3 % mod)

        s = 0
        for k in range(1, i + 1):
            s = add(s, abs(k - j))
        g[i] = add(g[i], (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod * val2 % mod * s % mod)

# Compute ff and gg
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == i:
            ff[i][j] = f[i]
            gg[i][j] = g[i]
            break
        else:
            ff[i][j] = ff[i - 1][j]
            gg[i][j] = gg[i - 1][j]
            for k in range(1, j + 1):
                val6 = (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % mod
                val7 = C[j][k]
                ff[i][j] = add(ff[i][j], val6 * val7 % mod)

                val8 = (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k]) % mod
                gg[i][j] = add(gg[i][j], val8 * val7 % mod)

                val9 = (gg[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % mod
                gg[i][j] = add(gg[i][j], val9 * val7 % mod)

print(gg[n][m])
